active_method.rationale: The disjoint 200-episode panel reproduced five failures, all for targets with angles from approximately -150 to -128 degrees. Three never entered the 1 cm tolerance, while two entered for only one to three steps before leaving. This concentrates evidence on a branch- or sector-dependent approach limitation, with hold instability as a consequence after marginal entry, and justifies developing a method that makes the relevant kinematic alternatives and approach state easier to control.
